03-dos-columnas.html.note: Implemented as 07 · Ruteo MIDI in operator/ (index.html, operator.css, operator.js): two columns, the fixed 3x3 sheet plus the notes-versus-CC sentence on the left, the three live fader rows and the diagnosis on the right. Data comes from GET /api/music on the same bridge, polled at 1 Hz only while the section is on screen; when the bridge does not answer the sheet stays visible and the panel says so. Symptom codes are translated to the operator's sentence. Print, copy and own-window (?section=routing) included. Read-only: no pad numbering, no write to mapping.json, no Ableton.
